headline: India levies 162.5% tax on bulk Scotch imports
hook: Scotch prices could surge as India hikes duty sharply.
what: The government announced a 162.5% tax on large‑volume Scotch whisky shipments. This follows a July trade deal with the UK that had reduced the tariff to 75%.
why: Higher costs may push up the price of imported whisky in bars and stores, so teens should expect pricier options. Keep an eye on local alternatives.

headline: Musk says he'd hire Nvidia CEO if needed
hook: Elon Musk’s quick reply fuels talk about tech power‑plays.
what: When asked whether he would bring Jensen Huang onto his team, Elon Musk answered that he would definitely do so if the situation called for it.
why: The comment highlights Musk’s admiration for top tech leaders and hints at possible future collaborations that could shape the industry for young innovators.

headline: Jharkhand, Mizoram, Odisha raise dearness allowance
hook: Your govt salary could get a boost this week.
what: The governments of Jharkhand, Mizoram and Odisha announced a hike in dearness allowance. The increase applies to eligible government employees as per each state’s rules.
why: Higher DA can improve real wages for young civil servants and students with part‑time govt jobs. Check your state’s eligibility to see if you benefit.

headline: Samsung launches One UI 9.5 beta with native App Lock
hook: Your Galaxy can now lock apps without extra apps.
what: Samsung has opened the One UI 9.5 beta program for eligible Galaxy devices. The update adds a built‑in App Lock feature, allowing users to protect apps directly from settings. The Galaxy S26 is among the phones that can enroll.
why: Built‑in privacy helps teens keep personal apps safe, and joining the beta lets early adopters test new features before public release.

headline: Small loans see rising defaults, experts urge caution
hook: Your next quick cash could become a debt pit.
what: A recent CRIF study shows that defaults on low‑value loans are climbing even as retail credit expands in India. The report outlines five steps borrowers can take to keep EMI payments on track and stay financially disciplined.
why: Young borrowers need to watch their loan commitments to avoid long‑term financial strain. Following the suggested practices can help manage repayments and protect credit scores.

headline: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million tokens
hook: A cheaper AI model now available for students and developers
what: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Neon and set its price at three dollars for every million input tokens. The company also made Gemini 4 Hydrogen the default AI model for its search and highlighted its speed for robotics, adding it to GitHub Copilot.
why: Lower costs make it easier for young Indians to experiment with advanced AI tools, whether for school projects or personal apps. You can start using it through Google services or GitHub Copilot.

headline: DGCA plans new registration system for prototype and production planes
hook: India's aviation regulator wants separate IDs for test and regular jets.
what: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has suggested a distinct registration approach for prototype and production aircraft. The proposal includes a shared pool of registration marks applicable to both categories.
why: This could streamline tracking of new aircraft and improve safety oversight, relevant for students interested in aviation careers. Keep an eye on updates if you plan to study aerospace.

headline: FDA confiscates over 20,000 litres oil in Pune
hook: Your cooking oil might be under scrutiny – see why
what: The Food and Drug Administration seized 20,085 litres of oil from a warehouse belonging to Avenue Supermarts in Ambi village, Pune. The action was taken after officials found violations of food‑safety rules.
why: It shows why checking product quality and certifications matters. Teens should look for proper labeling and safety approvals when buying cooking oil.

headline: Snapchat launches AI tools for AR lens creation
hook: Build Snapchat lenses faster with AI assistants.
what: Snapchat now offers developers AI helpers like Claude Code and Cursor to design augmented‑reality lenses. The Easy Lens CLI, available on npm, includes native binaries for three platforms, letting creators publish lenses directly.
why: Helps brands and teen creators launch interactive content quickly, expanding their reach on the platform.

headline: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60K staff, cites AI shift
hook: CEO nudges thousands to leave voluntarily as AI reshapes jobs
what: In October, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said the company gave voluntary buyout offers to about 60,000 employees. He chose this route instead of a large‑scale layoff. The move is linked to the impact of artificial intelligence on the workforce.
why: For young Indians eyeing tech careers, it signals rapid AI‑driven changes in big firms. Staying updated on AI skills could be crucial.

headline: Anthropic's $81.3bn IPO Sets Record as Biggest Ever
hook: AI startup lands the largest stock debut in history.
what: Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its initial public offering, the biggest ever recorded. The company set its debut share price at $83, above analysts’ expectations, and also secured $3 billion from investors in Japan.
why: The massive funding shows strong interest in AI ventures, signalling more opportunities and competition for young innovators in the tech space.

headline: Foreign investors pour record funds into Indian stocks
hook: India’s market got a boost from a historic FPI surge.
what: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) poured about Rs 99,000 crore (≈$10 billion) into Indian equities in November, the highest monthly inflow ever. The surge helped support stock prices despite rising inflation concerns.
why: Young investors see that foreign money can lift markets, but inflation remains a risk, so keep an eye on market trends before deciding.

headline: India signs deal with Israel to upgrade Barak missiles
hook: New upgrade boost for India's air defence.
what: The Indian government has signed an agreement with Israel to modernise the Barak missile system. The deal focuses on enhancing the existing defence hardware.
why: Strengthening missile capabilities helps protect the country’s airspace, a concern for all citizens. Stay informed about national security developments.

headline: 11 regions achieve full literacy, MP tops adult learning
hook: India’s literacy map just got brighter.
what: Eleven states and Union Territories have been declared fully literate. Madhya Pradesh recorded the highest number of adults taking learning programmes.
why: Higher literacy can boost job prospects and digital access for youth. Keep an eye on adult education schemes in your area.

headline: Microsoft CEO warns many systems can’t be patched
hook: AI could expose gaps in vital services, says Nadella.
what: Satya Nadella said a large part of critical infrastructure cannot be patched against threats. He mentioned the recent Outlook outage was minor. He added that AI brings both chances and new security hurdles for the connected world.
why: Young people using online services should stay aware of potential cyber risks and keep their devices updated. Understanding AI’s impact helps in choosing safe digital tools.

headline: Musk likens firing Jensen Huang to benching Michael Jordan
hook: A bold analogy from Elon Musk on tech leadership.
what: Elon Musk compared the idea of removing Jensen Huang to kicking Michael Jordan off a basketball team. He also said he doesn’t view Huang as disloyal to the United States.
why: The comment shows how highly tech CEOs are valued, indicating that leadership moves can shape the industry. Young Indians should stay aware of such opinions to better understand market trends.

headline: Akash Deep back in India squad after nine‑month injury layoff
hook: The fast bowler makes a comeback after months of rehab.
what: Akash Deep has been selected again for the Indian team following a nine‑month recovery from a back injury. He is working to rebuild his bowling career.
why: His return adds depth to India's pace attack, offering opportunities for upcoming matches. Young cricketers can see the value of perseverance and proper injury management.

headline: Nvidia interim CEO pledges raises for 49,000 staff
hook: New leader promises pay hikes in first company-wide talk.
what: Colette Kress, acting CEO of Nvidia, addressed employees in her inaugural all‑hands meeting. She announced salary increases for the firm’s 49,000 workers.
why: Higher pay could boost morale as the company navigates leadership change after Jensen Huang’s departure. Employees should stay tuned for rollout details.

headline: Nadella backs Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress
hook: Microsoft's chief says the new Nvidia leader has his support.
what: Satya Nadella said he trusts Colette Kress, who is running Nvidia temporarily after Jensen Huang stepped down. He voiced confidence in her leadership.
why: For young tech enthusiasts, it signals stability at a key AI chip maker, affecting future collaborations and job prospects in the sector.

headline: AI agents set to shake up web ad models
hook: Microsoft says bots could change how we shop online.
what: Microsoft's chief executive says AI agents may upend advertising‑based revenue on the internet. He warns that firms such as Amazon will need to adjust their customer‑acquisition tactics.
why: For young users, this could mean new ways to discover products without ads. Keep an eye on emerging AI tools that might replace traditional ads.

headline: BJP pushes Mathura temple issue amid internal unrest
hook: Party’s temple focus may hide deeper grievances.
what: The BJP has revived the Krishna Janmabhoomi debate. Analysts say the move aims to divert attention from growing dissatisfaction among its workers over new UGC equity guidelines, the SIR initiative, and seat‑sharing talks with allies.
why: For young Indians, it shows how political narratives can shift to sidestep internal challenges, urging them to stay critical of party messaging.

headline: Prince William and Kate meet PM Modi to end India tour
hook: Royal couple wraps up their Indian visit with a meeting of the Prime Minister.
what: Prince William and Princess Kate met Prime Minister Narendra Modi as their official tour of India concluded. The meeting marked the final engagement of their visit.
why: The encounter highlights the diplomatic ties between the UK and India, a point of interest for young Indians following global affairs.

headline: India drops Siraj, Jadeja for NZ opening Test
hook: A surprise lineup change ahead of the Wellington match.
what: India's selectors omitted fast bowler Mohammed Siraj and all‑rounder Ravindra Jadeja from the squad for the first Test against New Zealand. After winning the toss, India chose to bowl first in Wellington.
why: Young fans should watch how the new four‑bowler attack performs, as it could shape India's chances in the series.

headline: Anthropic IPO lands at $83, topping its target range
hook: Investors bet big on AI even as market wobbles.
what: Anthropic set its IPO price at $83 per share, higher than the $70‑$78 range it had hinted at. The pricing shows strong demand for the AI firm despite recent industry uncertainty.
why: For young Indians eyeing tech careers, it signals continued investor confidence in AI startups, suggesting more opportunities and funding in the sector.

headline: Anduril CEO urges three‑day emergency kits for all
hook: A top tech founder says be ready for any crisis.
what: Palmer Luckey, the founder of defense startup Anduril, said every American should keep food, water and medicine enough for three days. He made the comment on Wednesday.
why: Having a short‑term emergency stash can help you stay safe during sudden disruptions, so consider setting one up now.

headline: UEF and IIT-M Partner for Tamil Nadu Growth Conclave 2026
hook: A new state‑wide plan aims to boost ten key sectors for jobs and innovation.
what: The University of Economic Forum (UEF) and the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT-M) announced a partnership to organize the Tamil Nadu Growth Conclave 2026. The event will concentrate on ten priority sectors.
why: Focusing on multiple sectors could open fresh opportunities for students and startups in Tamil Nadu. Watch the conclave for possible internships, projects, or collaborations.

headline: Gold stays low as Fed vows to curb inflation
hook: Fed minutes keep gold under pressure.
what: The Federal Reserve’s meeting minutes indicated a continued focus on reducing inflation. As a result, gold prices stayed under pressure.
why: Lower gold prices can affect savings and investment choices for young Indians. Keep an eye on market moves before planning any gold purchases.

headline: Mahanadi Coalfields secures $245M from ADIA, LIC in IPO
hook: Big investors back a major coal IPO—what it means for the market.
what: Mahanadi Coalfields, a Coal India subsidiary, received anchor commitments worth over $245 million from Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and LIC. The company set its IPO price band at ₹129-136 per share, aiming to raise ₹9,000 crore. Anchor investors contributed Rs 2,295 crore.
why: The large backing signals confidence in the mining sector and could affect stock market trends. Young investors should watch the upcoming listing for potential investment opportunities.

headline: Islam projected to top Christianity by 2035
hook: A shift in global faith numbers is on the horizon.
what: A recent report says Islam will overtake Christianity as the biggest religion worldwide by 2035.
why: Knowing demographic trends helps young Indians stay aware of cultural changes; keep an eye on global shifts.

headline: GTA 6 finally launches in India after 13 years
hook: Dive back into Vice City and explore the new Leonida region now!
what: Rockstar Games released GTA 6 for Indian gamers after a 13‑year wait. The game returns to Vice City, a fictional city inspired by Miami, and adds a larger state called Leonida.
why: Players can now experience the latest open‑world adventure on their consoles or PCs. Check platform stores for availability and system requirements.

headline: Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches after 13-year wait
hook: The long‑awaited GTA VI hits global shelves today.
what: Grand Theft Auto VI is now available worldwide, ending a 13‑year gap since the previous title. The game has generated massive hype and early reviews are rolling in.
why: Gamers can now play the new release; checking reviews will show if it meets the hype.

headline: PlayStation Network glitches hit users before GTA VI drop
hook: Your PS5 might be offline just as GTA VI lands.
what: PlayStation’s online service experienced widespread outages affecting thousands of gamers. The issue surfaced only hours before the highly anticipated GTA VI release.
why: The downtime could delay players from accessing the new game or online features, so check for updates or try restarting the console.

headline: Semaglutide shown to curb binge eating and boost body confidence
hook: A diabetes drug may help with eating habits and self‑image.
what: A recent study found that the GLP‑1 medication semaglutide lowered binge‑eating symptoms and reduced body dissatisfaction. Participants reported improved eating‑behavior scores after using the drug.
why: If you struggle with overeating or negative body image, emerging research suggests semaglutide could be a therapeutic option, but medical advice is essential before considering it.

headline: Modi meets British royals, pledges stronger UK‑India ties
hook: They discussed climate innovation and deeper cooperation.
what: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met the Prince and Princess of Wales. The leaders talked about boosting relations between the United Kingdom and India. Modi praised the Earthshot Prize for encouraging new ideas to tackle environmental challenges.
why: Closer UK‑India ties could bring more education and job options for Indian youth. Highlighting the Earthshot Prize shows a focus on climate solutions that affect the next generation.

headline: GTA 6 Hits India After 13-Year Wait
hook: The long‑awaited open‑world saga finally lands in India.
what: Rockstar Games released Grand Theft Auto VI, and it is now available in India. The game returns to the series’ iconic Vice City and expands to the new Leonida region.
why: Indian gamers can now explore the new open‑world setting on consoles and PCs. Pre‑orders and early access are open, so fans can dive in now.

headline: Sam Altman unbothered by Andrew Garfield playing him
hook: He isn’t surprised by a film that casts Andrew Garfield as him
what: Sam Altman said his life feels so strange that a movie about him doesn’t shock him. He added that being portrayed by Andrew Garfield isn’t even among his top ten weird moments.
why: It shows how tech leaders are becoming part of pop culture, a trend young Indians may notice in entertainment.

headline: Snapchat adds AI helpers for easy AR lens creation
hook: Create cool AR filters just by typing what you imagine
what: Snapchat announced that developers can now use AI assistants such as Claude Code and Cursor to build AR lenses. Users can simply describe the desired effect in plain language and the AI handles the entire creation process.
why: This makes designing AR filters faster for young creators, letting them experiment without coding skills. Teens can try the new tools to bring their ideas to life on Snapchat.

headline: Man duped of ₹1L in Green Gas cyber scam
hook: Watch out: fake Green Gas offers can drain your cash fast
what: A man fell victim to a cyber fraud linked to Green Gas. He lost ₹1 lakh in the scam.
why: The case warns about online scams that promise cheap gas. Young users should verify any such offers before sending money.

headline: Nvidia lifts outlook, Anthropic IPO draws attention
hook: Big chip maker ups its game while AI startup eyes the market
what: Nvidia announced higher earnings guidance for the coming period. At the same time, investors are watching the upcoming IPO of Anthropic. The news is influencing market activity.
why: Tech stocks affect the broader market, which can impact savings and investment options for youth. Keep an eye on these developments if you’re interested in tech careers or investing.

headline: Modi meets British royals, talks India-UK partnership
hook: India's PM chats with Prince William and Kate on future ties
what: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Prince William and Princess Catherine in London. They discussed strengthening India‑UK relations. Modi also praised the Earthshot Prize’s environmental work.
why: The dialogue could boost collaborations in education, technology and climate projects that affect youth. Keep an eye on upcoming joint initiatives.
